image_description: A close-up, high-angle photograph of a green tiger beetle (Cicindela species) on a light gray, textured surface. The beetle exhibits a metallic emerald green exoskeleton with distinct cream-colored spots on its elytra. Its head is broad with large compound eyes and visible mandibles. Several legs are visible, appearing slender and jointed, though some are partially obscured or blend into the background.
